objects.description: During [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058), threat actors used [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) to dump LSASS memory.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
objects.description_fa: در طول [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058)، عوامل تهدید از [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) برای تخلیه حافظه LSASS استفاده کردند.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
